Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a contralateral mediastinal shift to the right, which is the hallmark radiographic sign of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away; in contrast, lung collapse would typically cause an ipsilateral shift toward the opacity. *(guided by t000002)*
